steps.content: You carry the inspector on your back, and relying on his incoherent, mumbling directions, you circle around the block three times before arriving at his residence... or maybe it's his office, or simply another garbage dump.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Adjutant Nightingale has dispatched personnel to control and investigate those "Sleepwalkers," as well as clean up the traces of Sinner activity.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'll stand guard downstairs. Adjutant Nightingale said that Eastsiders hate Sinners. We must keep a low profile so as not to hinder your work...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate! Come, quick! Toasted marshmallows, braised meatballs, and sweet buttermilk tea! Eastside really is a **** awesome place! Come thank me... argh!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...I won't let her run around again, Chief. Please keep a close watch on your belongings next time.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If anything happens, call me and I will be there right away.
You change out of your vomit-covered "cocktail clothes" and back into your MBCC jacket. You feel much more at ease.

steps.speaker: Voice in bathroom
steps.content: Cough cough... Blegh...
You hear the toilet flush. The door opens and Doyle comes out. He looks more normal now, but is still a far cry from a "reliable inspector."

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Okay, let's get to know each other. I'm Doyle, inspector... I mean, former inspector. I will get my job back, soon.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'm Noms, agent from the 9th Agency.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...You work for those old foxes, too? Tsk, you don't look like it. You look like a newbie at most.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Thanks... for what you did just now. I'm not used to fighting those things.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: The bigwigs want you to take over this case? Ha... Fine. Whatever.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Remember this place. Use it as a contact point, or a safe house, up to you. The 9th Agency checked for safety issues already, so it'll have to do. You'd be even less welcome elsewhere.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Then there's this notebook. It's trash. I won't need it anymore. You can have it.
You take over Doyle's notebook, which looks like it holds a bunch of records. You can read them after you finish asking your questions.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Do you think Sinners caused the incidents?

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: I don't know. This isn't Syndicate. There aren't any Sinners here in Eastside, so not that much trouble around here.
He throws himself onto the couch and looks away. No wonder he has "temporarily left his post due to personal reasons." He has simply stopped caring about everything.
But you've dealt with many more difficult characters back at the MBCC. You can handle him.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: The bigwigs know you've been treated unfairly and sent me to assist you, Inspector.
I need your wisdom for the sake of the public's safety.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...Pfft. Why'd they send such a starry-eyed rookie.
He turns around and sits up.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: You do know how to handle the "black goo." You've been running errands in West District, haven't you? Then remember, this isn't West District. Eastsiders won't be so calm when they see things like Mania.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: There hasn't been a Mania outbreak east of the Rust in years. The detection station covers all of Eastside. Although it cannot pinpoint precise locations, it can still detect if a general area has anything unusual.

Indeed, before the start of the operation, Nightingale gave the two Sinners accompanying you special "escape configurations" to avoid detection. It's said that this intervention required special high-level access.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: We can only be sure that there is an intermittently active Sinner in District 14. As for whether or not he or she has anything to do with the Sleepwalkers... I'm no expert, so I can't say.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: If we do things my way, we should just be practical and focus on the Sleepwalkers themselves.
The doorbell interrupts your conversation.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: ...What good timing.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: This is a "witness" who has volunteered to come. I'll let you question him for practice in a bit. But don't say anything unnecessary.
The door opens, and a handsome, muscled man with black circles around his eyes walks in.

steps.speaker: Man who Walked in
steps.content: Oh, so the bigwigs really did send someone to check up on things. Doyle, you better be on your best behavior. Maybe this bureaucrat gentleman will help you get your job back.
steps.female_content: Oh, so the bigwigs really did send someone to check up on things. Doyle, you better be on your best behavior. Maybe this bureaucrat lady will help you get your job back.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Go **** yourself!

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: That mouth of yours really doesn't know when to talk tough and when to do sweet-talking. No wonder your wife left you...
With that, the doctor tilts his head and dodges the ashtray that Doyle threw over, flicks the ashes from his shoulders, and closes the door. The two seem to be old acquaintances.
